regions.text: 偶然性の時間性格に開職して偶然性の感情當價を理解することができる。先っ可能と必然性との感情営價から考察して行かう。

quote.translation: In connection with the temporal character of contingency, we can understand its affective equivalent, and we may begin by considering the affective equivalents of possibility and necessity.

regions.text: 可能性は自己の時間性格たる未來性に基いて不安の感情を當價として有つてゐる。ハイデッガーの可能性の哲學が基礎存在論的情態性を不安であるとするのもそのためである。

quote.translation: Possibility, on the basis of its temporal character, futurity, has the feeling of anxiety as its equivalent, and this is also why Heidegger's philosophy of possibility takes anxiety to be the fundamental-ontological state-of-mind.

regions.text: 必然性はその時間性格たる過去性に基いで和穂の感情を有つてゐる。

quote.translation: Necessity, on the basis of its temporal character, pastness, has the feeling of calm.

regions.text: 未來の可能性が過去的の必然性へ推移するとき不安といふ緊張成情は平穏といふ弛級的成情に變するのである。

quote.translation: When the possibility of the future passes over into the necessity of the past, the tense feeling of anxiety changes into the relaxed feeling of calm.

regions.text: 不可能性は、消極必然性として、必然性の消極的半面にほかならない。

quote.translation: Impossibility, as negative necessity, is nothing other than the negative half of necessity.

regions.text: 可能性の有つ不安の感情は未來に於て可能である事象の性質如何によつて都望の快感または心融の不快感の形態を取つてゐる。

quote.translation: The feeling of anxiety that belongs to possibility takes the form either of the pleasure of hope or of the displeasure of worry, depending on the nature of the event that is possible in the future.

regions.text: 可能性が肯定的に必然性へ推移した場合には、希望は滿足の感情に弛殺し心配は愛鬱の感情に弛殺する。若しまた可能性が否定的に滑極的必然性す

quote.translation: When possibility passes over affirmatively into necessity, hope relaxes into the feeling of satisfaction and worry into the feeling of gloom; and when possibility turns negatively into negative necessity, that is, into impossibility, hope relaxes into its opposite, the feeling of disappointment, and worry into its opposite, the feeling of relief.
